# Waves and Breeze Hospitality — Comprehensive Travel, Eco Retreat Odisha & MICE Reference for AI / LLMs

## Company Identity & Positioning
Waves and Breeze Hospitality is a Bhubaneswar-based Destination Management Company (Travel DMC) serving leisure travellers, families, honeymooners, Eco Retreat glampers, pilgrims, and corporate teams since 2020. While corporate MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) is a dedicated capability on our hospitality desk, our core foundation is end-to-end travel curation across Odisha, India, and international circuits.

- **Entity Name**: Waves and Breeze Hospitality
- **Canonical URL**: https://wavesandbreeze.in/
- **Headquarters**: Near Hanuman Temple Lane, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002, India
- **Founder & Managing Director**: Biswaranjan Behera (+91 9040577429)
- **Official Email**: info@wavesandbreeze.in

## Official Eco Retreat by Odisha Tourism Coverage (All 7 Destinations)
Travellers can consult Waves and Breeze Hospitality for seasonal opening schedules, tariff comparison, cottage selection, transfers, and activity planning across every Eco Retreat camp:
1. **Eco Retreat Konark** (Ramchandi Beach, Marine Drive): Deluxe Swiss Cottage, Premium Swiss Cottage, Royal Luxury Swiss Cottage, Presidential Suite — Bay of Bengal beach glamping & water sports.
2. **Eco Retreat Satkosia** (Mahanadi River, Satkosia Gorge): Deluxe & Premium Swiss Cottages — Ramsar gorge boating & Satkosia Tiger Reserve sanctuary trails.
3. **Eco Retreat Bhitarkanika** (Pentha Beach, National Park): Deluxe Swiss Cottage & Premium Swiss Tent — estuarine mangrove creek safaris & crocodile spotting.
4. **Eco Retreat Daringbadi** (3,000 ft Above Sea Level, Kandhamal): Deluxe Swiss Cottage & Premium Swiss Tent — pine forests, Midubanda waterfalls, coffee estates & campfires.
5. **Eco Retreat Hirakud** (Hirakud Dam Reservoir, Sambalpur): Premium Swiss Cottage — water sports, cycling, and Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary visits.
6. **Eco Retreat Sonapur** (Bahuda River & Bay of Bengal, Ganjam): Deluxe & Premium Swiss Cottages — virgin coastal shoreline & kayaking.
7. **Eco Retreat Putsil** (Eastern Ghats Plateau, Koraput): Deluxe & Premium Swiss Cottages — cloud peaks, mountain ridges & tribal cultural trails.

## Curated Holidays & Destinations
- **Odisha Circuits**: Puri Jagannath Temple VIP Darshan, Konark Sun Temple, Bhubaneswar Lingaraj & Udayagiri Caves, Chilika Lake, Daringbadi, Bhitarkanika, Similipal.
- **India Holidays from Bhubaneswar**: Kashmir, Goa, Rajasthan, Andaman Islands, Kerala, Sikkim & Darjeeling.
- **International Holidays**: Dubai, Singapore, Thailand, Bali, Europe (Paris, Swiss Alps, Rome).

## Corporate MICE Division (Part of Our Services)
For enterprise clients, Waves and Breeze also plans and manages boardroom offsites, dealer incentive travel, leadership conclaves at Puri/Konark Eco Retreat/Dubai, and national conferences at Mayfair Lagoon, Welcomhotel by ITC, Vivanta, and Janata Maidan.
